name: nRF9151 LTE-M/NB-IoT/GNSS SiP (baseline cellular, owner decision)
notes: Replaces the obsolete nRF9160-SICA-R7. 11,739 in stock (the -R7 reel variant is 0 stock, 100 due 10-05). Same 1 MB/256 KB/M33 64 MHz as the nRF9160: no RAM gain, so no on-device ML here. 11x12x1 mm LGA vs 10x16x1.04 mm (-20% area, new footprint, not drop-in). Adds Power Class 5 20 dBm, DECT NR+, NB-NTN. Use for no-phone fallback; ~0.14-0.35 mAh per LTE-M voice command vs ~0.01 mAh over BLE.
